content: Ta gizay yelettida nay laatay izas gidikkoka izi biidi laattana gakkanaas ayllefe dumma gidenna.
Iza aaway gida wodey gakkanaas izi bana dichchizayta, tamaarsizayta kushen gam7ees.
Nunikka kase Ayana yo7os guuththa naa mala diza wode hayssa ha alameza wogaa garsan haaretti de7idos.
Gido attiin kase ba qoppi woththida wodey gakkiin Xoossay maccassafe yelettidi wogaa naagida ba naaza nuus yeddides.
Hessika nuni iza nayta gidana malanne woga garsan dizayta wozzana mala hanides.
Intte iza nayta gidida gishshas Xoossaa, «Aabboo» giidi xeygiza ba naaza Ayana nu wozinan yeddides.
Hessa gishshas hayssafe guye ne naappe attiin aylle gidakka; neni naa gidida gishshas Xoossi nena bayssa laattizaade histtides.
Galatiya Asaas Phawuloosa Qofa
Intte Xoos eranaappe kase Xoos gidontta eeqatas aylleta.

Ha7i gidikko Xoos erideta; qasseka Xoossan erettideta; histtiin qasseka guye simmidi gede go7ay baynda coo daabursiza timirteko waani simmidetii? Simmidi qasseka aylleteththa qambaran waaxettana koyeetii?
Dumma gallassata, aginata, wodetanne layththata intte bonchcheeta.
Ta inttenara daaburdayssi coo mela gidandee gaada babbays.
Ta ishatoo! Ta inttena misatida mala intteka tana misatana mala ta inttena woossays; intte tana aykkoka qohibeekketa.
Intte eriza mala ta inttes koyro Mishiraachcho qaala sabbakiday sako gaasonna.
Ta sakoy inttes meto gidiinkka tana salettibeekketa woykko tana harasettibeekketa; gido attiin intte tana Xoossa kiitanchcha malanne hessafekka bollara Yesus Kirstoosa mala mokki ekkideta.
Histtiin ha7i he intte ufayssay awa bidee? Inttes hanizaaz gididaakko intte intte ayfe taas kessi immanaas guye gonttayssa ta inttes markkattays.
Tani tumaa inttes kessa yootida gishshas inttes morkke gidadinaasha?
Heyti asati inttena baakko ekkanaas daabureettes attiin lo7os daaburettenna; istti koyzay inttena nuuppe shaakkidi ba as histtanaassa.
Lo7os mindateththi lo7o; hessika hananaas bessizay ubba wode gidikkofe attiin ta inttenara diza wode xalla gidoppo.
Ta naytoo! Kirstoosi intte wozinan xaafettiin ta beyana gakkanaas intte gishshas ta miixattays.
Ta intte gishshas qofan metotadis; ta dandayzaakko ha7i intte giddon beettada inttena lo7eththa tamaarsizaakko ay mala dosazinaa!
Agaaronne Saara
Intteno Woga garsan aqana koyzayto ane taas yootite; wogay ay gizaakko siyibeekketii?
Abrahaames issoy aylleyfe issoy qasse goqayppe yelettida nam7u nayti dizayssi Geeshsha Maxaafan xaafettides.
Aylleyfe yelettida naazi asho wogaa mala yelettides; hankko goqayppe yelettidayssi ufayssa qaalaa mala yelettides.
Hayti nam7u maccassati nam7u caaqota bessizayta gidida gishshas hayssi leemisos imettides; koyro caaqoya Siina zumaa bolla gidashe aylleteththas gidiza nayta yelizaaro; izakka Aggaaro.
Hessa gishshas Aggaara Arabe biittan diza Siina zumaa gishshas gidada ha7i diza Yerusalaame katamayo misatawus; iza ba naytara aylleteththan dawus.
Pude bolla salon diza Yerusalaamey gidikko goqa gidada dawus; izakka nu aayo.
«Neni yelontta maynneye ufayetta! Hanne miixatta eronttaaree! ‹Ilili› ga waassa; azinay dizaarippe azinay bayndaari nayti darida» geetetti Geeshsha Maxaafan xaafettides.
Hessa gishshas ta ishatoo! Intteka Yisaaqa mala ufayssa qaalaa naytakko.
Asho shene mala yelettidayssi Ayana wolqqan yelettidayssa gooddides; ha7ikka goodeththon dees.
Gido attiin Geeshsha Maxaafay qasse ay gizee? «Aylleyo izi naazara digga; aylley nay goqay naara laattenna» gees.
Hessa gishshas ta ishatoo! Nuni goqay nayta attiin aylley nayta gidokko.
